title: The price table has no rows for Claude Sonnet 5.5, the GPT-6 models, or GPT-5.2 and earlier
foundBy: session agent, auditing `pricing.json` against the provider price pages fetched on 2026-09-29; filed at the host's request: "file ledger entries in the tracer repo to report any issues with the pricing"
details:
The provider pages fetched on 2026-09-29 list models that `pricing.json` does not.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 is $2 input, $2.50 and $4 for cache writes, $0.20 for cache reads and $10 output per million tokens. Its name contains `claude-sonnet-5`, whose rates are the same, so it is priced correctly by coincidence (TRC-049).

OpenAI lists four GPT-6 models, each with a short-context and a long-context tier. Short context, in input, cached input, cache writes and output per million tokens:

| Model | Input | Cached input | Cache writes | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gpt-6-astra` | $10 | $1 | $12.50 | $50 |
| `gpt-6-sol` | $2 | $0.20 | $2.50 | $10 |
| `gpt-6.1-sol` | $2 | $0.10 | $2.50 | $10 |
| `gpt-6-luna` | $0.10 | $0.01 | $0.125 | $0.50 |

It also lists `gpt-5.2`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5-mini` and `gpt-5-nano`. None of these names contains a table key, so their sessions get no estimate. No session on the host that found this used any of them.
